TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi beforefieldinit SKGraphiteRecorder extends SkiaSharp.SKObject

Docs.summary: Records drawing work for later insertion into a Graphite context.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
A recorder captures the drawing work that targets Graphite-backed surfaces. Create one with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.CreateRecorder(System.Int64)>, draw into surfaces associated with it, then call `Snap` to produce an <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecording> that can be inserted into the context and submitted to the GPU.
This type wraps a native Skia resource and implements `IDisposable`. Dispose it when done, either with a `using` statement or by calling `Dispose()` directly.

Docs.summary: Gets the graphics backend that drives this recorder.
Docs.value: One of the enumeration values that identifies the backend.
